description: Look at a clip. Returns a contact sheet image of evenly spaced frames with a legend mapping each cell to a timestamp, so you can pick trim points or check what happens when. Pass 'at' to get one full-size frame at a specific time instead.

at.description: Return a single frame at this time instead of a sheet.

count.description: Number of frames in the sheet (default 12, max 64).

end.description: Only sample up to this time.

path.description: Path to the video or GIF.

remote.description: Extract frames on the configured server.

start.description: Only sample from this time onward (seconds or m:ss).

name: gif_frames
